paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter using solid-state nuclear magnetic resonance
notes: CASPER (Cosmic Axion Spin Precession Experiment) searches for ultralight axion-like dark matter using solid-state NMR on 207Pb spins in ferroelectric PMN-PT crystal. The mass range 162-166 neV (Compton frequency 39.1-40.2 MHz) is searched by sweeping magnetic field over 21 steps from B_0=4.45 to 4.35 T. The EDM coupling limit |g_d| < 9.5 × 10^-4 GeV^-2 is flat across the entire searched range (two-point representation of flat limit). The paper also reports gradient coupling constraint |g_aNS| < 2.8 × 10^-1 GeV^-1, but EDM is presented as main result. From Section V and Figure 3(a) of the paper. 95% confidence level based on 5σ threshold (3.355σ) in power spectral density analysis.
